source: query-phrasing workflow, run 44814883666 (DataForSEO, FR market, fr)
method: Each text names the observed phrasings it follows. 'observed': people type that form; 'adapted': the form is observed but reworded so the slot works for any noun of either gender, a person or a place, singular, with the words that agree with it written as groups; 'unsupported': no query in the data. Citations whose words disagree with the noun's gender are skipped.
